mapper.sql: scope_type AS scopeType, scope_id AS scopeId, level, permanent_muted AS permanentMuted, muted_until AS mutedUntil, quiet_start AS quietStart, quiet_end AS quietEnd, quiet_tz AS quietTz, suppress_broadcast AS suppressBroadcast, suppress_team_status AS suppressTeamStatus, show_preview AS showPreview, version, (muted_until IS NOT NULL AND muted_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AS mutedActive
mapper.select: SELECT FROM im_notify_pref WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND scope_type = #{scopeType} AND scope_id = #{scopeId}
SELECT FROM im_notify_pref WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND scope_type = #{scopeType} AND scope_id = #{scopeId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM im_notify_pref WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND scope_type IN (1, 2) ORDER BY scope_type, scope_id LIMIT 500
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_notify_pref(member_id, scope_type, scope_id, level, permanent_muted, muted_until, quiet_start, quiet_end, quiet_tz, suppress_broadcast, suppress_team_status, show_preview, version) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeId}, #{level}, #{permanentMuted}, #{mutedUntil}, #{quietStart}, #{quietEnd}, #{quietTz}, #{suppressBroadcast}, #{suppressTeamStatus}, #{showPreview}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE level = VALUES(level), permanent_muted = VALUES(permanent_muted), muted_until = VALUES(muted_until), quiet_start = VALUES(quiet_start), quiet_end = VALUES(quiet_end), quiet_tz = VALUES(quiet_tz), suppress_broadcast = VALUES(suppress_broadcast), suppress_team_status = VALUES(suppress_team_status), show_preview = VALUES(show_preview), version = version + 1
mapper.select: SELECT club_id AS clubId, level, version, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM im_club_notify_default WHERE club_id = #{clubId}
SELECT club_id AS clubId, level, version, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM im_club_notify_default WHERE club_id = #{clubId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO im_club_notify_default(club_id, level, version, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{clubId}, #{level}, 1, #{updatedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE im_club_notify_default SET level = #{level}, version = version + 1, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE club_id = #{clubId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT type FROM im_conversation WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT unread_count AS unread, last_read_msg_id AS lastRead, muted, deleted FROM im_conversation_member WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) FROM im_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 0

SELECT c.id AS conversationId, c.type + 0 AS type, m.unread_count AS unread, m.last_read_msg_id AS lastRead, m.muted AS muted, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM im_message_mention mm JOIN im_message msg ON msg.id = mm.message_id WHERE msg.conversation_id = c.id AND msg.id > m.last_read_msg_id AND msg.status = 0 AND ((mm.mention_type = 'USER' AND mm.target_id = #{memberId}) OR mm.mention_type = 'EVERYONE')) AS mentions FROM im_conversation_member m JOIN im_conversation c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} AND m.deleted = 0 LIMIT 2000
